17.english_reference: And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּאָֽסְפוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽ יַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּ מִּצְפָּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήχθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν τῇ σκοπιᾷ .
traditions.VUL: contra quos congregáti fílii Israel in Maspha castrametáti sunt .
traditions.KJV: And the children of Israel assembled themselves together , and encamped in Mizpeh .

18.english_reference: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמְר֨וּ הָ עָ֜ם שָׂרֵ֤י גִלְעָד֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֔
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπον ὁ λαὸς οἱ ἄρχοντες Γαλαάδ , ἀνὴρ πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Dixerúntque príncipes Gálaad sínguli ad próximos suos :
traditions.KJV: And the people [ and ] princes of Gilead said one to another ,

18.english_reference: What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon

traditions.WLC: הוּ מִ֣י הָ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָחֵ֔ל לְ הִלָּחֵ֖ם בִּ בְנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: Τίς ὁ ἀνὴρ ὅστις ἂν ἄρξηται παρατάξασθαι πρὸς υἱοὺς Ἀμμών ,
traditions.VUL: Qui primus ex nobis contra fílios Ammon cœ́perit dimicáre ,
traditions.KJV: What man [ is he ] that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon ?

18.english_reference: he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead

traditions.WLC: יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לְ רֹ֔אשׁ לְ כֹ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד
traditions.LXX: ἔσται εἰς ἄρχοντα πᾶσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Γαλαάδ ;
traditions.KJV: he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead .
